rootCause: Service directory duplicate: the upgraded legacy tree carries id159 `/business/service` (top-level C leaf, pagePerm business:service:list, no registered page route -> 404) alongside the current id1818 `/business/service-catalog` (with children 1819/1820/1821). The service seed's findSeedMenuID only matches `/business/service-catalog`, so id159 is never merged and recurs on every start.

Service in-page tab click no response: ServiceCatalog uses `<Tabs defaultActiveTab={activeTab}>` (uncontrolled) and never calls navigate() on change, so a mounted page only reads the initial URL once; clicking a submenu/tab changes nothing.
Ordering: filedist (id1039 sort50) and argocd (id1409 sort60) sort after the system block (sorts 20-50), pushing them to the very bottom.

ArgoCD label collision: titleKey operations.cicd.argocd.menu renders '应用发布', identical to the K8s release child, so the sidebar has two '应用发布' buttons -> strict-mode click failure and ambiguity (confirmed by before-all all-business-clicks.json id134).
